before: The player's goal is to configure the fixed pipe network within at most 30 successful rotations so that Source water reaches both Sinks without producing any invalid Source-reachable outlet.
after: The player's goal is to configure the fixed pipe network within at most 30 successful rotations so that Source water reaches both Sinks without producing any invalid Source-reachable outlet under the modified Block layout.
The V7 Block layout determines which cells cannot rotate and which outgoing connections are invalid because they point toward Blocks.
